description: This Java class 'DeviceArtPainter' handles rendering device frames and overlays for Android device screenshots, including caching, scaling, and compositing images with effects like shadows and reflections. It manages device-specific data and descriptors to produce visual representations of devices in the layout and preview tools.

classes.name: DeviceData
classes.description: Holds device-specific data including portrait and landscape frame configurations, and manages retrieval of appropriate frame data based on size and orientation.

classes.name: FrameData
classes.description: Represents image data for a device frame in a specific orientation, including methods for image scaling, caching, and compositing with effects like shadows and reflections.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DeviceArtPainter.

methods.name: hasDeviceFrame
methods.description: Checks if a device has a dedicated frame image.

methods.name: getDeviceData
methods.description: Retrieves or creates device-specific data for rendering.

methods.name: findDescriptor
methods.description: Finds a device art descriptor based on device ID or name.

methods.name: isTablet
methods.description: Determines if a device is a tablet based on its ID or screen size.

methods.name: getDescriptors
methods.description: Returns the list of available device art descriptors.

methods.name: paintFrame
methods.description: Paints a device frame around specified screenshot coordinates with optional effects.

methods.name: createFrame
methods.description: Creates a BufferedImage of a device frame around a given image, with optional effects and scaling.

methods.name: computeBounds
methods.description: Calculates the bounding rectangle of the device screen within a scaled image.

methods.name: stretchImage
methods.description: Stretches an image to specified dimensions using NinePatch scaling.

methods.name: getScreenPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of the device screen within the image based on device and orientation.

methods.name: getFrameMaxOverhead
methods.description: Returns the maximum overhead factor added by device frames.

methods.name: getFrameWidthOverhead
methods.description: Returns the width overhead factor of the device frame.

methods.name: getFrameHeightOverhead
methods.description: Returns the height overhead factor of the device frame.
